items.stem: In a .NET Semantic Kernel app, what is the role of the kernel object?

options.text: It references AI services, manages plugins and provides execution context for functions
options.rationale: Correct: the kernel orchestrates services, plugins and execution.

options.text: It is the large language model itself
options.rationale: The model is a connected service, not the kernel.
That is not the kernel's purpose.

options.text: It replaces the need for any AI provider
options.rationale: The kernel still calls a provider.

items.explanation: Correct: the kernel orchestrates services, plugins and execution.

items.stem: Which TWO practices make function calling safer in an agent that can file tickets and send email? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Expose only the minimum set of functions the task needs
options.rationale: Correct: least-privilege tool exposure limits misuse.

options.text: Require human approval before consequential actions
options.rationale: Correct: approval gating guards destructive actions.

options.text: Allow the model to call any function with no limits
Hide all function descriptions from the model
options.rationale: Descriptions are needed for correct selection; hiding them harms reliability.

items.explanation: Correct: least-privilege tool exposure limits misuse.

items.stem: An assistant must answer from company policy documents rather than the model's training. What should be added to the kernel app?

options.text: Embeddings plus a memory/vector store to retrieve and inject policy context
options.rationale: Correct: retrieval grounds answers in the documents.

options.text: A longer system prompt insisting it be correct
options.rationale: Instructions alone do not supply the documents.

items.explanation: Correct: retrieval grounds answers in the documents.
